request: Plan our push and in-app messages: when to ask for permission, which moments get a push instead of an email, how many pushes a day and a week, the copy, and what to track. Owners say we send too many notifications.
business: Example Booking Software, an online booking and scheduling app for small service businesses (invented example)

app.users: owners and front-desk staff of small service businesses
